# LibRaw Runtime

- Version: `0.22.1`
- Source: `https://www.libraw.org/download`
- License options: `LGPL-2.1` or `CDDL-1.0`

This folder vendors the Windows runtime pieces used by the desktop app:

- `bin/libraw.dll`
- `lib/libraw.lib`
- `include/libraw/*.h`

The original license texts are copied alongside this file.
